best_for.en: Students who already know Spanish/Catalan and want to tap into the Barcelona startup hub.

not_ideal_for.en: Students looking for a 100% English program.

main_strengths.en: The programme makes its aerospace specialisations and its non-English first-year delivery explicit, preventing a costly language surprise.
main_strengths.tr: Program, havacılık-uzay uzmanlaşmalarını ve İngilizce olmayan ilk yıl eğitimini açıkça belirtir; böylece maliyetli bir dil sürprizini önler.

main_risks.en: Year one is Catalan and year two English; this is not a 100% English degree and non-Catalan/non-Spanish applicants should not treat it as one.

application_reality.en: Affordable living in Terrassa and access to the Catalonia tech hub, but the 2-year program's reliance on Catalan in the first year is a massive barrier for non-Spanish/Catalan speakers.
application_reality.tr: Terrassa'da uygun fiyatlı yaşam ve Katalonya teknoloji merkezine erişim, ancak 2 yıllık programın ilk yılında Katalancaya dayanması, İspanyolca/Katalanca konuşmayanlar için büyük bir engeldir.

overall_recommendation.en: Avoid unless you are fluent in Spanish/Catalan.
